scripts.docker:install: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -w /app cms bun install
scripts.docker:test:all: bun run docker:test:sqlite && bun run docker:test:postgres
scripts.docker:test:bench: docker compose run --rm cms-test-sqlite bun run test:bench && docker compose run --rm cms-test bun run test:bench
scripts.docker:test:load: docker compose run --rm cms-test-sqlite bun run test:load && docker compose run --rm cms-test bun run test:load
scripts.docker:test:integration: docker compose run --rm cms-test-sqlite bun run test:integration
scripts.test: CROMBOLO_SQLITE_FILE=:memory: CROMBOLO_ADMIN_PASSWORD=test-password CROMBOLO_COMPONENTS_DIR=output/test-views CROMBOLO_MEDIA_DIR=output/test-media CROMBOLO_LOGS_DIR=output/test-logs CROMBOLO_LOG_TO_CONSOLE=false bun test
scripts.test:all: bun run test:sqlite && bun run test:postgres
scripts.test:ci: CROMBOLO_SQLITE_FILE=:memory: CROMBOLO_ADMIN_PASSWORD=test-password CROMBOLO_COMPONENTS_DIR=output/test-views CROMBOLO_MEDIA_DIR=output/test-media CROMBOLO_LOGS_DIR=output/test-logs CROMBOLO_LOG_TO_CONSOLE=false bun test
